title: Locality of the equality tester
statement: For every positive integer $n$, the tester that samples two coordinates independently and uniformly and accepts exactly when their values agree is a local tester for the property of being a constant Boolean string, with rate $1$. Specifically, it accepts every constant string with probability $1$, and for every $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$ and every string whose normalized Hamming distance from every constant string exceeds $\varepsilon$, its rejection probability is strictly greater than $\varepsilon$.
